capital.evidence_quote: Bishkek is the capital and largest metropolis of the Kyrgyz Republic

sources.title: National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic

currency.evidence_quote: The Kyrgyzstani Som (KGS, с) is the official currency; trades around 89 KGS to 1 USD

timezone.evidence_quote: Kyrgyzstan Time operates year-round on UTC+6 without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Kyrgyzstan is 220V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The national electrical power grid operating frequency is standard 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: European standard Type C round two-pin and Schuko Type F sockets are universal

sources.title: Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic

police.evidence_quote: Dial 102 for emergency police assistance throughout Kyrgyzstan

sources.title: Ministry of Health of the Kyrgyz Republic

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 103 for emergency medical services and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 101 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 112 is the nationwide unified emergency dispatch number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Police units patrol Bishkek and Issyk-Kul resort shores via +996 312 888 102 and 112

advisory_headline.tr: Kırgızistan Orta Asya'nın en misafirperver ve dağ yürüyüşü için güvenli ülkelerindendir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Kyrgyzstan is exceptionally welcoming, scenic, and safe for mountain trekking; exercise normal precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Kirgisistan ist ein sicheres und gastfreundliches Reiseland für Bergwanderer; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Кыргызстан — одна из самых гостеприимных и безопасных стран Центральной Азии для горного туризма.
advisory_headline.es: Kirguistán es un destino sumamente acogedor y seguro para el senderismo de montaña; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Kyrgyzstan reach approximately 35.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Bishkek measure 62.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Mega (MegaCom), Beeline KG, and O! offer cheap high-speed 4G eSIMs at Manas International Airport (FRU) in Bishkek. CBT (Community Based Tourism) operates homestays and yurt camps across Song-Kul and Issyk-Kul.

sources.title: Ministry of Digital Development of the Kyrgyz Republic

esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: SIM card purchases require passport registration under national communication laws

religion.value: Islam (approx. 88%, predominantly Sunni) and Russian Orthodoxy (approx. 10%) with deep nomadic heritage

sources.title: National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic

religion.evidence_quote: Nomadic pastoralist traditions, epic poetry (Manas), and Islamic faith shape Kyrgyz culture

festivals.value: World Nomad Games, Nooruz (Spring Equinox on March 21), National Horse Games Festival (Kok-Boru at Song-Kul), Birds of Prey Festival

sources.title: Department of Tourism of the Kyrgyz Republic

festivals.evidence_quote: Kok-Boru horse games and salburun eagle falconry are central to traditional nomadic festivals

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Never step on or walk across the dastarkhan (tablecloth spread on the floor for meals). When staying in yurts, remove your shoes before stepping onto carpets. Taking photos of border checkpoints or military areas is strictly forbidden. Russian and Kyrgyz are both official languages.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Nomadic hospitality etiquettes regarding yurt entries and dastarkhan are deeply revered

tipping.value: A 10-15% service charge is automatically added to restaurant bills in Bishkek. Tipping mountain trekking horsemen and guides ($5-10 per day) is customary.
tipping.evidence_quote: Most urban restaurants include a 10-15% service fee directly on the bill
